title: Dead Malls?
content: Does anyone else have recurring dreams of a mall that is, like too many of their real-life counterparts, in a state of decline? There is a specific mall that I've visited many times in dreams, and it is a mall which has clearly seen better days. It starts out as a 1-level enclosed mall which may have a few stores open (and it's something of a victory for me if I discover a still-operating and busy anchor store in that section.) But at one end, the mall makes a 45° turn to the left, where it quickly turns in to a wide, "super-regional" 3-level mezzanine. The storefronts in this section are mostly if not completely shuttered. The cavernous common area, while still presumably open to the public, is literally dark as night. There is a certain pervasive depressing feeling while there, knowing that it used to be a pleasant, bustling shopping center. There may be some other people (zombies?) wandering about, but not many. Sometimes, outside the opposite end of the 3-story mall, across a short parking area/driveway, there is a "big box" store that is open for business. Though it, too, can be in varying states of decline. Sometimes, the store's popularity can shift within the same dream, possibly in a matter of minutes!
